title: Second-hand: smart choice or second best?
situation: A consumer website for young people has started a forum thread called "Second-hand: smart choice or second best?" Users are invited to share their experience of buying used clothes, books or electronics. Write a post for the forum.
situationHu: Egy fiataloknak szóló fogyasztói oldal fórumán a használt termékek vásárlásáról írnak; írj bejegyzést a saját tapasztalatodról.

points.text: describe something you have bought second-hand and where you bought it
compare buying second-hand with buying new (e.g. price, quality, choice)
give advice to people who would like to start buying second-hand

usefulPhrases.en: I've been buying second-hand clothes for about two years now.
usefulPhrases.hu: Nagyjából két éve veszek használt ruhákat.

usefulPhrases.en: a charity shop / a flea market / an online marketplace
It cost a fraction of the original price.
Whereas new products come with a guarantee, …
usefulPhrases.hu: Míg az új termékekre jár garancia, …

usefulPhrases.en: The quality can vary a lot.
It's worth checking … before you buy.
